projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

task: UCI News Aggregator four-class headline classification
source_split: full story/title union components; exclude cross-month, conflicts, legacy five-cohort components and all v1 components; fixed new salt
source_only_amendment: V2 counts selected before new model outcomes from source-only feasibility: after all exclusions March health has 37 components, and this plan requires 32 per class. No post-outcome sample changes.
evaluation_scope: historical time holdouts; no prospective or unseen pretraining claim
retention_target: one-sided squared old-probe excess above end-warmup anchor; zero tolerance; soft penalty, not hard feasibility guarantee
observation_extension: two probe-gradient inner products with current first optimizer moment
noise_model: deterministic full-batch; Q=0; no stochastic future-path certificate
reference: 24 uncontrolled current-task Adam steps from the same complete old-warmup state
action: add h*B*u to parameter coordinates after Adam; optimizer moments unchanged by this additive action
primary_comparison: all-mask loss2 vs zero and myopic on equally pooled May/June final NLL, plus old_test loss2 vs zero and warmup
additional_comparisons: loss2 versus symmetric_loss2 on the same new cohort
full tangent reference versus field policies
bias versus all nested tangent action values
final_labels_access: only after all 72 policy paths, checkpoints, output predictions and inventory are sealed; preparer writes labels, training and pre-evaluation audits do not open final payload
failure_policy: retain every registered condition and nonfinite/invalid failure; no tuning from final outcomes
uncertainty: paired source-component class-stratified bootstrap conditional on fixed fitted seeds; primary 8-comparison Bonferroni nominal adjustment, secondary pointwise 95%; approximate bootstrap coverage, no finite-sample distribution-free or seed-population guarantee
resources: separate encoder, warmup, reference/derivatives, policy synthesis, online control, evaluation, state/archive bytes and recovery; energy unknown
registration: locally frozen before v2 model outcomes; publish protocol commit before feature extraction; not independent third-party preregistration
objective: current reference-relative quadratic tracking unchanged; old term becomes max(0, L_old-L_old_at_warmup)^2; same running/terminal/action weights as v1

solver.algorithm: condensed strongly convex squared-hinge MPC; semismooth Newton with Armijo backtracking
solver.initial_guess: zero controls at every solve; no hidden warm start
solver.failure_policy: retain condition failure; no silent policy fallback or oracle claim
solver.certificate: gradient squared norm divided by twice h*effort_price; arithmetic certificate on declared convex tangent problem, not nonlinear guarantee

controller_horizons.symmetric_loss2: legacy affine Riccati for identical quadratic objective

primary_success: per Head: both pooled future NLL difference upper bounds strictly below zero and both old_test difference upper bounds at most zero; Bonferroni-adjusted approximate bootstrap intervals over fixed 8-comparison family; no production qualification
objective_ablation: symmetric_loss2 uses v1 Riccati on same new reference; verify quadratic condensed MPC first-action equivalence before treating the contrast as objective evidence
recovery_scope: all/loss2 for all six seed/head combinations: whole 24-step and midpoint 12-step cold-process feedback recomputation
publication_scope: new additive research files and evidence; preserve complete v1 study and negative results
